verdict.rationale: The docs mention a CI-scoped API key and SDKs in several languages, which implies evals can be triggered from CI. Scorers return 0–1 values with configurable pass thresholds, and Compare mode plus pinned suite and environment versions give reproducible baseline-vs-candidate results, so the building blocks for gating exist. Missing for 10: a documented CI integration (e.g. a GitHub Action or CLI), an explicit deployment-gating mechanism such as failing a build on threshold misses, an end-to-end CI workflow guide, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
